class MockBus:
    """Мини-ППИ 8255 + клавиатура + принтер, достаточные для образа демо.

    Поведение повторяет согласованную карту:

    * ``0x0000`` PA -- выход: маска сегментов (режим 0x89) или байт принтеру
      (режим 0xA9);
    * ``0x0001`` PB -- выход: единица в разряде знакоместа (и строки матрицы);
    * ``0x0002`` PC -- вход: столбцы клавиатуры, 0 = нажато;
    * ``0x0003``    -- регистр управления 8255.
    """

    COLUMNS = 8
    ROWS = 8

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.control = None
        self.pa = 0x00
        self.pb = 0x00
        self.cells = [0x00] * self.COLUMNS
        self.pressed = set()
        self.ext_writes = []          # (addr, value)
        self.ext_reads = []           # addr
        self.port_writes = []         # (port, value)
        self.port_reads = []          # port
        self.printer = bytearray()
        self.cell_history = []        # кортежи cells после каждой защёлки
        self.ticks = 0

    # -- HardwareBus ------------------------------------------------------
    def tick(self, cycles: int) -> None:
        self.ticks += cycles

    def ext_read(self, addr: int, code: bool = False) -> int:
        addr &= 0xFFFF
        self.ext_reads.append(addr)
        if addr in (0x0002, 0x000A):
            return self._columns()
        if addr in (0x0000, 0x0008):
            return self.pa
        if addr in (0x0001, 0x0009):
            return self.pb
        return 0xFF

    def ext_write(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        addr &= 0xFFFF
        value &= 0xFF
        self.ext_writes.append((addr, value))
        if addr in (0x0000, 0x0008):
            self.pa = value
            if self._printer_mode():
                self.printer.append(value)
        elif addr in (0x0001, 0x0009):
            self.pb = value
            self._commit()
        elif addr in (0x0003, 0x000B):
            self.control = value
        else:
            self.pa = value

    def port_read(self, port: int) -> int:
        self.port_reads.append(port)
        return 0xFF

    def port_write(self, port: int, value: int) -> None:
        self.port_writes.append((port, value))

    def serial_write(self, byte: int) -> None:
        self.printer.append(byte & 0xFF)

    def irq_requested(self) -> int:
        return 0

    # -- 8255 semantics ---------------------------------------------------
    def _printer_mode(self) -> bool:
        """True when group A is in mode 1 (0xA9): PA writes feed the printer."""
        return self.control is not None and (self.control & 0x80) and \
            ((self.control >> 5) & 0x03) == 0x01

    def _commit(self) -> None:
        """PB selects a digit: latch PA into it (one-hot, active high)."""
        if self.pb:
            index = self.pb.bit_length() - 1
            if 0 <= index < self.COLUMNS:
                self.cells[index] = self.pa
        self.cell_history.append(tuple(self.cells))

    def _columns(self) -> int:
        """Column bits of the row selected by PB: 0 = pressed."""
        value = 0xFF
        if self.pb:
            row = self.pb.bit_length() - 1
            for col in range(self.COLUMNS):
                if (row, col) in self.pressed:
                    value &= ~(1 << col) & 0xFF
        return value

    # -- test helpers -----------------------------------------------------
    def press(self, name: str) -> None:
        self.pressed.add(self._position(name))

    def release(self, name: str) -> None:
        self.pressed.discard(self._position(name))

    @staticmethod
    def _position(name: str):
        for row, cells in enumerate(KEY_LAYOUT):
            for col, key in enumerate(cells):
                if key == name:
                    return (row, col)
        raise KeyError(f"{name!r} не найдена в KEY_LAYOUT")

    # -- наблюдение -------------------------------------------------------
    def display_chars(self) -> str:
        out = []
        for mask in self.cells:
            base = mask & 0x7F
            ch = SEG_BY_MASK.get(base, "?")
            out.append(ch + ("." if mask & 0x80 else ""))
        return "".join(out)

    def display_digits(self) -> str:
        return "".join(ch for ch in self.display_chars() if ch.isdigit())

    def printer_text(self) -> str:
        raw = bytes(b for b in self.printer if b not in (0x0D,))
        return raw.decode("koi8-r", errors="replace")

    def printer_lines(self) -> list:
        return [line for line in self.printer_text().split("\n")]

    def writes_to(self, addr: int) -> list:
        return [v for a, v in self.ext_writes if a == addr]

    def reads_of(self, addr: int) -> int:
        return self.ext_reads.count(addr)


class DemoRig:
    """Образ демо + ядро 8051 + mock-плата, с удобным прогоном."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.image, self.symbols = build_demo()
        self.rom = ROM("demo-stand-in")
        self.rom.load_block(DEMO_BASE, self.image)
        self.bus = MockBus()
        self.cpu = CPU8051(self.rom, self.bus)

    def run(self, steps: int) -> int:
        done = self.cpu.run_steps(steps)
        if self.cpu.halted:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"программа остановлена: {self.cpu.error} "
                f"(PC=0x{self.cpu.pc:04X})")
        if self.cpu.error:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"ошибка ядра: {self.cpu.error} (PC=0x{self.cpu.pc:04X})")
        return done

    def run_until(self, predicate, limit: int = 400_000, chunk: int = 500) -> bool:
        total = 0
        while total < limit:
            self.run(chunk)
            total += chunk
            if predicate():
                return True
        return False

    def press(self, name: str, steps: int = 4000, settle: int = 1500) -> None:
        """Нажать клавишу, дать антидребезгу сработать и отпустить."""
        self.bus.press(name)
        self.run_until(
            lambda: self.cpu.ram[self.symbols["KEY_STABLE"]] != 0xFF,
            limit=steps * 4, chunk=200)
        self.bus.release(name)
        self.run_until(
            lambda: self.cpu.ram[self.symbols["KEY_STABLE"]] == 0xFF,
            limit=settle * 4, chunk=200)

    def entry_bcd(self) -> int:
        addr = self.symbols["ENTRY"]
        digits = [self.cpu.ram[addr + i] for i in range(4)]
        return sum(d << (8 * i) for i, d in enumerate(digits))

    def entry_value(self) -> int:
        """Введённая сумма в копейках (BCD -> int)."""
        addr = self.symbols["ENTRY"]
        value = 0
        for byte in reversed([self.cpu.ram[addr + i] for i in range(4)]):
            value = value * 100 + (byte >> 4) * 10 + (byte & 0x0F)
        return value

        table = self.image[addr:addr + 64]
        expected = []
        for row in KEY_LAYOUT:
            for name in row:
                expected.append(KEY_CODES[name])
        self.assertEqual(list(table), expected,
                         "KEYMAP в cashier.asm разошлась с KEY_LAYOUT")

    def test_segment_table_matches_python_table(self):
        addr = self.symbols["DIGIT_SEG"] - self.result.base
        table = self.image[addr:addr + 10]
        self.assertEqual(list(table),
                         [SEGMENTS[str(d)] for d in range(10)])

    def test_load_demo_image_matches_build(self):
        self.assertEqual(load_demo_image(), self.image)

    def test_no_acall_in_the_demo(self):
        """ACALL (0x11/0x31/...) the emulator core does not implement.

        ``tools/asm51.py`` supports it (задание), но демо-программа его не
        использует: m8051/cpu.py не декодирует 0x11..0xF1.
        """
        for addr in range(self.symbols["START"], self.result.end):
            byte = self.image[addr - self.result.base]
            self.assertNotIn(byte, (0x11, 0x31, 0x51, 0x71,
                                    0x91, 0xB1, 0xD1, 0xF1),
                             f"ACALL по адресу 0x{addr:04X}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Работа образа на ядре m8051 с mock-платой
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TestDemoOnMockBus(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):

    # -- инициализация ----------------------------------------------------
    def test_program_runs_and_initialises_the_ppi(self):

        self.assertIn(PORT_MAP["MODE_DISPLAY"],
                      self.rig.bus.writes_to(PORT_MAP["PPI_CTRL"]),
                      "программа не записала управляющее слово 0x89")

    def test_power_on_selftest_lights_every_segment(self):
        all_segments = SEGMENTS["8"] | 0x80
        self.rig.run(4000)
        pattern = tuple([all_segments] * DISPLAY["columns"])
        self.assertIn(pattern, self.rig.bus.cell_history,
                      "нет самопроверки 'test tpu' (все сегменты)")

    def test_display_is_refreshed_repeatedly(self):
        self.rig.run(3000)

        pb_writes = self.rig.bus.writes_to(PORT_MAP["PPI_PB"])
        self.assertGreater(len(pa_writes), 3 * DISPLAY["columns"])
        self.assertGreater(len(pb_writes), 3 * DISPLAY["columns"])
        # каждая запись в PB -- единица ровно в одном разряде
        for value in pb_writes:
            self.assertIn(value, (0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08,
                                  0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80))

    def test_keyboard_port_is_scanned(self):
        self.rig.run(3000)
        self.assertGreater(self.rig.bus.reads_of(PORT_MAP["PPI_PC"]), 8)

    def test_key_press_changes_the_display(self):
        self.rig.run(4000)                        # инициализация + самопроверка
        before = tuple(self.rig.bus.cells)

        self.assertEqual(self.rig.entry_value(), 5)

        self.rig.press("СБРОС")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.entry_value(), 0)
        self.rig.press("00")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.entry_value(), 0)
        self.rig.press("1")
        self.rig.press("2")
        self.rig.press(".")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.entry_value(), 1200,
                         '". " и "00" достраивают копейки')

        self.rig.press("2")
        self.rig.press("5")

        total_addr = self.rig.symbols["TOTAL"]

                        self.rig.bus.display_chars())

    def test_cancel_voids_the_last_item(self):

        for key in "250":

        self.assertIn("НЕДОСТАТОЧНО", self.rig.bus.printer_text())

    def test_main_loop_stays_responsive(self):

        self.rig.run(50_000)

        self.assertIsNone(self.rig.cpu.error)

{"content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Тесты демонстрационной (stand-in) программы кассы и сборщика asm51.

Программа ``firmware/demo/cashier.asm`` -- **не** оригинальная прошивка: это
замена, написанная машинным кодом MCS-51 и собранная ``tools/asm51.py``.
Тесты проверяют три вещи:

1. ``tools/asm51.py`` кодирует каждую поддерживаемую инструкцию так, что
   ``tools/disasm.py`` читает её обратно эквивалентно (``selftest``).
2. Собранный образ действительно работает на ядре ``m8051``: настраивает ППИ,
   циклически обновляет индикатор, сканирует клавиатуру, реагирует на нажатие
   и печатает чек.
3. Если готова плата ``board/cashboard.py`` (владелец hal-ppi), то тот же образ
   проверяется на ней; иначе тест помечается ``SkipTest``.

Запуск::

    python -m unittest tests.test_demo_firmware -v
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import unittest

from m8051 import CPU8051, ROM
from tools import asm51
from firmware.demo import (
    DEMO_BASE,
    DEMO_LABEL,
    DISPLAY,
    KEY_CODES,
    KEY_LAYOUT,
    PORT_MAP,
    SEGMENTS,
    build_demo,
    build_result,
    load_demo_image,
)

SEG_BY_MASK = {mask: ch for ch, mask in SEGMENTS.items()}

#: Mnemonics the stand-in program's assembler must support (задание).
REQUIRED_MNEMONICS = (
    "MOV", "MOVX", "MOVC", "ADD", "ADDC", "SUBB", "INC", "DEC",
    "ANL", "ORL", "XRL", "CLR", "CPL", "SETB", "JB", "JNB", "JBC",
    "JC", "JNC", "JZ", "JNZ", "CJNE", "DJNZ", "SJMP", "AJMP", "LJMP",
    "ACALL", "LCALL", "RET", "RETI", "PUSH", "POP", "NOP", "RL", "RR",
    "SWAP", "XCH", "MUL", "DIV", "DA",
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mock-плата: ровно контракт docs/board_contract.md + карта ППИ от hal-ppi
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class MockBus:
    """Мини-ППИ 8255 + клавиатура + принтер, достаточные для образа демо.

    Поведение повторяет согласованную карту:

    * ``0x0000`` PA -- выход: маска сегментов (режим 0x89) или байт принтеру
      (режим 0xA9);
    * ``0x0001`` PB -- выход: единица в разряде знакоместа (и строки матрицы);
    * ``0x0002`` PC -- вход: столбцы клавиатуры, 0 = нажато;
    * ``0x0003``    -- регистр управления 8255.
    """

    COLUMNS = 8
    ROWS = 8

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.control = None
        self.pa = 0x00
        self.pb = 0x00
        self.cells = [0x00] * self.COLUMNS
        self.pressed = set()
        self.ext_writes = []          # (addr, value)
        self.ext_reads = []           # addr
        self.port_writes = []         # (port, value)
        self.port_reads = []          # port
        self.printer = bytearray()
        self.cell_history = []        # кортежи cells после каждой защёлки
        self.ticks = 0

    # -- HardwareBus ------------------------------------------------------
    def tick(self, cycles: int) -> None:
        self.ticks += cycles

    def ext_read(self, addr: int, code: bool = False) -> int:
        addr &= 0xFFFF
        self.ext_reads.append(addr)
        if addr in (0x0002, 0x000A):
            return self._columns()
        if addr in (0x0000, 0x0008):
            return self.pa
        if addr in (0x0001, 0x0009):
            return self.pb
        return 0xFF

    def ext_write(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        addr &= 0xFFFF
        value &= 0xFF
        self.ext_writes.append((addr, value))
        if addr in (0x0000, 0x0008):
            self.pa = value
            if self._printer_mode():
                self.printer.append(value)
        elif addr in (0x0001, 0x0009):
            self.pb = value
            self._commit()
        elif addr in (0x0003, 0x000B):
            self.control = value
        else:
            self.pa = value

    def port_read(self, port: int) -> int:
        self.port_reads.append(port)
        return 0xFF

    def port_write(self, port: int, value: int) -> None:
        self.port_writes.append((port, value))

    def serial_write(self, byte: int) -> None:
        self.printer.append(byte & 0xFF)

    def irq_requested(self) -> int:
        return 0

    # -- 8255 semantics ---------------------------------------------------
    def _printer_mode(self) -> bool:
        """True when group A is in mode 1 (0xA9): PA writes feed the printer."""
        return self.control is not None and (self.control & 0x80) and \
            ((self.control >> 5) & 0x03) == 0x01

    def _commit(self) -> None:
        """PB selects a digit: latch PA into it (one-hot, active high)."""
        if self.pb:
            index = self.pb.bit_length() - 1
            if 0 <= index < self.COLUMNS:
                self.cells[index] = self.pa
        self.cell_history.append(tuple(self.cells))

    def _columns(self) -> int:
        """Column bits of the row selected by PB: 0 = pressed."""
        value = 0xFF
        if self.pb:
            row = self.pb.bit_length() - 1
            for col in range(self.COLUMNS):
                if (row, col) in self.pressed:
                    value &= ~(1 << col) & 0xFF
        return value

    # -- test helpers -----------------------------------------------------
    def press(self, name: str) -> None:
        self.pressed.add(self._position(name))

    def release(self, name: str) -> None:
        self.pressed.discard(self._position(name))

    @staticmethod
    def _position(name: str):
        for row, cells in enumerate(KEY_LAYOUT):
            for col, key in enumerate(cells):
                if key == name:
                    return (row, col)
        raise KeyError(f"{name!r} не найдена в KEY_LAYOUT")

    # -- наблюдение -------------------------------------------------------
    def display_chars(self) -> str:
        out = []
        for mask in self.cells:
            base = mask & 0x7F
            ch = SEG_BY_MASK.get(base, "?")
            out.append(ch + ("." if mask & 0x80 else ""))
        return "".join(out)

    def display_digits(self) -> str:
        return "".join(ch for ch in self.display_chars() if ch.isdigit())

    def printer_text(self) -> str:
        raw = bytes(b for b in self.printer if b not in (0x0D,))
        return raw.decode("koi8-r", errors="replace")

    def printer_lines(self) -> list:
        return [line for line in self.printer_text().split("\n")]

    def writes_to(self, addr: int) -> list:
        return [v for a, v in self.ext_writes if a == addr]

    def reads_of(self, addr: int) -> int:
        return self.ext_reads.count(addr)


class DemoRig:
    """Образ демо + ядро 8051 + mock-плата, с удобным прогоном."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.image, self.symbols = build_demo()
        self.rom = ROM("demo-stand-in")
        self.rom.load_block(DEMO_BASE, self.image)
        self.bus = MockBus()
        self.cpu = CPU8051(self.rom, self.bus)

    def run(self, steps: int) -> int:
        done = self.cpu.run_steps(steps)
        if self.cpu.halted:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"программа остановлена: {self.cpu.error} "
                f"(PC=0x{self.cpu.pc:04X})")
        if self.cpu.error:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"ошибка ядра: {self.cpu.error} (PC=0x{self.cpu.pc:04X})")
        return done

    def run_until(self, predicate, limit: int = 400_000, chunk: int = 500) -> bool:
        total = 0
        while total < limit:
            self.run(chunk)
            total += chunk
            if predicate():
                return True
        return False

    def press(self, name: str, steps: int = 4000, settle: int = 1500) -> None:
        """Нажать клавишу, дать антидребезгу сработать и отпустить."""
        self.bus.press(name)
        self.run_until(
            lambda: self.cpu.ram[self.symbols["KEY_STABLE"]] != 0xFF,
            limit=steps * 4, chunk=200)
        self.bus.release(name)
        self.run_until(
            lambda: self.cpu.ram[self.symbols["KEY_STABLE"]] == 0xFF,
            limit=settle * 4, chunk=200)

    def entry_bcd(self) -> int:
        addr = self.symbols["ENTRY"]
        digits = [self.cpu.ram[addr + i] for i in range(4)]
        return sum(d << (8 * i) for i, d in enumerate(digits))

    def entry_value(self) -> int:
        """Введённая сумма в копейках (BCD -> int)."""
        addr = self.symbols["ENTRY"]
        value = 0
        for byte in reversed([self.cpu.ram[addr + i] for i in range(4)]):
            value = value * 100 + (byte >> 4) * 10 + (byte & 0x0F)
        return value


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Сборщик
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TestAssembler(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_selftest_round_trips_every_encoding(self):
        """Каждая инструкция asm51 читается disasm.py обратно эквивалентно."""
        self.assertEqual(asm51.selftest(verbose=False), 0)

    def test_supports_every_required_mnemonic(self):
        for mnemonic in REQUIRED_MNEMONICS:
            self.assertIn(mnemonic, asm51.ENC,
                          f"нет мнемоники {mnemonic}")

    def test_labels_immediates_and_two_pass(self):
        result = asm51.assemble(
            """
            VAL    EQU 0x1234
                    ORG 0x0000
                    LJMP START
            START:  MOV  DPTR,#VAL
                    MOV  A,#LOW(START)
                    MOV  A,#HIGH(START)
                    SJMP START
                    END
            """)
        self.assertEqual(result.symbols["VAL"], 0x1234)
        start = result.symbols["START"]
        self.assertEqual(result.image[start - result.base:][:6],
                         bytes((0x90, 0x12, 0x34, 0x74, start & 0xFF,
                                (start >> 8) & 0xFF)))

    def test_intel_hex_output_is_loadable(self):
        result = build_result()
        text = result.intel_hex()
        self.assertTrue(text.startswith(":02000000"))
        self.assertTrue(text.strip().endswith(":00000001FF"))
        rom = ROM("hex").load_hex_text(text)
        self.assertEqual(rom.byte(DEMO_BASE), result.image[0])

    def test_immediate_overflow_is_reported(self):
        result = asm51.assemble("        ORG 0\n        MOV A,#300\n")
        self.assertTrue(any("truncated" in w for w in result.warnings))

    def test_unknown_mnemonic_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(asm51.AsmError):
            asm51.assemble("        ORG 0\n        FROB A,#1\n")

    def test_relative_jump_out_of_range_raises(self):
        source = "        ORG 0\nL:      NOP\n" + "        NOP\n" * 200 + \
                 "        SJMP L\n"
        with self.assertRaises(asm51.AsmError):
            asm51.assemble(source)

    def test_bit_addresses_use_the_mcs51_convention(self):
        # 20h.3 -- это бит 0x03 (байт 0x20, третий бит), ACC.3 -- бит 0xE3.
        result = asm51.assemble(
            "        ORG 0\n"
            "        SETB 20h.3\n"
            "        SETB ACC.3\n"
            "        CLR  C\n"
            "        END\n")
        self.assertEqual(result.image[:6], bytes((0xD2, 0x03, 0xD2, 0xE3,
                                                  0xC3, 0xFF))[:6])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Сборка демо-программы
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TestDemoImage(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.result = build_result()
        cls.image = cls.result.image
        cls.symbols = cls.result.symbols

    def test_reset_vector_starts_at_zero(self):
        self.assertEqual(DEMO_BASE, 0x0000)
        self.assertEqual(self.image[0], 0x02)          # LJMP
        target = (self.image[1] << 8) | self.image[2]
        self.assertEqual(target, self.symbols["START"])

    def test_image_is_labelled_a_stand_in(self):
        self.assertIn("ДЕМО", DEMO_LABEL)
        self.assertIn("НЕ ОРИГИНАЛЬНАЯ", DEMO_LABEL)

    def test_receipt_text_is_koi8r_and_mentions_the_demo(self):
        text = self.result.image
        start = self.symbols["S_DEMO"]
        blob = text[start - self.result.base:start - self.result.base + 40]
        decoded = blob.split(b"\x00")[0].decode("koi8-r")
        self.assertIn("ДЕМО-ПРОГРАММА", decoded)

    def test_keymap_table_matches_python_layout(self):
        addr = self.symbols["KEYMAP"] - self.result.base
        table = self.image[addr:addr + 64]
        expected = []
        for row in KEY_LAYOUT:
            for name in row:
                expected.append(KEY_CODES[name])
        self.assertEqual(list(table), expected,
                         "KEYMAP в cashier.asm разошлась с KEY_LAYOUT")

    def test_segment_table_matches_python_table(self):
        addr = self.symbols["DIGIT_SEG"] - self.result.base
        table = self.image[addr:addr + 10]
        self.assertEqual(list(table),
                         [SEGMENTS[str(d)] for d in range(10)])

    def test_load_demo_image_matches_build(self):
        self.assertEqual(load_demo_image(), self.image)

    def test_no_acall_in_the_demo(self):
        """ACALL (0x11/0x31/...) the emulator core does not implement.

        ``tools/asm51.py`` supports it (задание), но демо-программа его не
        использует: m8051/cpu.py не декодирует 0x11..0xF1.
        """
        for addr in range(self.symbols["START"], self.result.end):
            byte = self.image[addr - self.result.base]
            self.assertNotIn(byte, (0x11, 0x31, 0x51, 0x71,
                                    0x91, 0xB1, 0xD1, 0xF1),
                             f"ACALL по адресу 0x{addr:04X}")

# 3. Работа образа на ядре m8051 с mock-платой
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TestDemoOnMockBus(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.rig = DemoRig()

    # -- инициализация ----------------------------------------------------
    def test_program_runs_and_initialises_the_ppi(self):
        self.rig.run(3000)
        self.assertIn(PORT_MAP["MODE_DISPLAY"],
                      self.rig.bus.writes_to(PORT_MAP["PPI_CTRL"]),
                      "программа не записала управляющее слово 0x89")

    def test_power_on_selftest_lights_every_segment(self):
        all_segments = SEGMENTS["8"] | 0x80
        self.rig.run(4000)
        pattern = tuple([all_segments] * DISPLAY["columns"])
        self.assertIn(pattern, self.rig.bus.cell_history,
                      "нет самопроверки 'test tpu' (все сегменты)")

    def test_display_is_refreshed_repeatedly(self):
        self.rig.run(3000)
        pa_writes = self.rig.bus.writes_to(PORT_MAP["PPI_PA"])
        pb_writes = self.rig.bus.writes_to(PORT_MAP["PPI_PB"])
        self.assertGreater(len(pa_writes), 3 * DISPLAY["columns"])
        self.assertGreater(len(pb_writes), 3 * DISPLAY["columns"])
        # каждая запись в PB -- единица ровно в одном разряде
        for value in pb_writes:
            self.assertIn(value, (0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08,
                                  0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80))

    def test_keyboard_port_is_scanned(self):
        self.rig.run(3000)
        self.assertGreater(self.rig.bus.reads_of(PORT_MAP["PPI_PC"]), 8)

    def test_key_press_changes_the_display(self):
        self.rig.run(4000)                        # инициализация + самопроверка
        before = tuple(self.rig.bus.cells)
        self.rig.press("5")
        after = tuple(self.rig.bus.cells)
        self.assertNotEqual(before, after,
                            "нажатие клавиши не изменило буфер индикатора")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.entry_value(), 5)
        # разряд копеек -- крайнее правое знакоместо
        self.assertEqual(after[7], SEGMENTS["5"])
        # знакоместо 0 -- индикатор режима ("0" = ввод)
        self.assertEqual(after[0], SEGMENTS["0"])

    def test_clear_entry_and_zero_keys(self):
        self.rig.run(4000)
        self.rig.press("5")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.entry_value(), 5)
        self.rig.press("СБРОС")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.entry_value(), 0)
        self.rig.press("00")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.entry_value(), 0)
        self.rig.press("1")
        self.rig.press("2")
        self.rig.press(".")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.entry_value(), 1200,
                         '". " и "00" достраивают копейки')

    def test_sum_registers_an_item_and_prints_a_line(self):
        self.rig.run(4000)
        self.rig.press("1")
        self.rig.press("2")
        self.rig.press("5")
        self.rig.press("0")                       # 12.50
        self.rig.press("СУММА")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.entry_value(), 0, "ввод должен очищаться")
        total_addr = self.rig.symbols["TOTAL"]
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.cpu.ram[total_addr], 0x50)   # 12.50 младший
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.cpu.ram[total_addr + 1], 0x12)
        text = self.rig.bus.printer_text()
        self.assertIn("12.50", text)
        self.assertIn("ДЕМО-ПРОГРАММА", text)     # шапка помечена как замена

    def test_subtotal_and_total_keys_show_the_running_total(self):
        self.rig.run(4000)
        for key in "100":
            self.rig.press(key)
        self.rig.press("СУММА")                   # итог 1.00
        self.rig.press("ПОДЫТОГ")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.cpu.ram[self.rig.symbols["MODE"]], 1)
        digits = self.rig.bus.display_digits()
        self.assertTrue(digits.endswith("100"),
                        f"на индикаторе нет итога: {digits!r}")
        self.rig.press("ИТОГ")
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.cpu.ram[self.rig.symbols["MODE"]], 2)

    def test_full_sale_prints_receipt_with_change(self):
        self.rig.run(4000)
        # 12.50
        for key in "1250":
            self.rig.press(key)
        self.rig.press("СУММА")
        # 3.00
        for key in "300":
            self.rig.press(key)
        self.rig.press("СУММА")
        # наличными 20.00
        for key in "2000":
            self.rig.press(key)
        self.rig.press("ОПЛ")

        text = self.rig.bus.printer_text()
        self.assertIn("ИТОГ", text)
        self.assertIn("НАЛИЧНЫМИ", text)
        self.assertIn("СДАЧА", text)
        self.assertIn("СПАСИБО", text)
        self.assertIn("15.50", text)              # итог
        self.assertIn("20.00", text)              # внесено
        self.assertIn("4.50", text)               # сдача 20.00 - 15.50
        self.assertIn("12.50", text)
        self.assertIn("3.00", text)
        # чек закрыт
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.cpu.ram[self.rig.symbols["ITEM_N"]], 0)
        # режим "сдача" -- на индикаторе 4.50
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.cpu.ram[self.rig.symbols["MODE"]], 3)
        self.assertTrue(self.rig.bus.display_digits().endswith("450"),
                        self.rig.bus.display_chars())

    def test_cancel_voids_the_last_item(self):
        self.rig.run(4000)
        for key in "500":
            self.rig.press(key)
        self.rig.press("СУММА")                   # 5.00
        for key in "250":
            self.rig.press(key)
        self.rig.press("СУММА")                   # +2.50 = 7.50
        self.rig.press("ОТМЕНА")                  # -2.50 = 5.00
        total_addr = self.rig.symbols["TOTAL"]
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.cpu.ram[total_addr], 0x00)
        self.assertEqual(self.rig.cpu.ram[total_addr + 1], 0x05)
        self.assertIn("ОТМЕНА", self.rig.bus.printer_text())

    def test_not_enough_cash_does_not_print_change(self):
        self.rig.run(4000)
        for key in "1000":
            self.rig.press(key)
        self.rig.press("СУММА")                   # 10.00
        for key in "500":
            self.rig.press(key)
        self.rig.press("ОПЛ")                     # внесено 5.00 < 10.00
        self.assertIn("НЕДОСТАТОЧНО", self.rig.bus.printer_text())

    def test_main_loop_stays_responsive(self):
        """Главный цикл -- опросный: индикатор и клавиатура работают всегда."""
        self.rig.run(50_000)
        bus = self.rig.bus
        # за 50k инструкций должно быть много полных рефрешей
        self.assertGreater(len(bus.writes_to(PORT_MAP["PPI_PB"])), 100)
        self.assertGreater(bus.reads_of(PORT_MAP["PPI_PC"]), 100)
        self.assertIsNone(self.rig.cpu.error)

def _board_available():
    try:
        module = importlib.import_module("board.cashboard")
    except Exception as exc:                  # pragma: no cover - зависит от hal-ppi
        return False, f"board/cashboard.py недоступен: {exc!r}"
    if not hasattr(module, "CashRegisterBoard"):
        return False, "в board/cashboard.py нет CashRegisterBoard"
    return True, ""


BOARD_OK, BOARD_REASON = _board_available()

class TestDemoOnRealBoard(unittest.TestCase):

        from board.cashboard import CashRegisterBoard
        self.board = CashRegisterBoard()
        image, self.symbols = build_demo()
        self.rom = ROM("demo-stand-in")
        self.rom.load_block(DEMO_BASE, image)
        self.cpu = CPU8051(self.rom, self.board)

    def _run(self, steps: int) -> None:
        self.cpu.run_steps(steps)
        self.assertFalse(self.cpu.halted,
                         f"CPU остановлен: {self.cpu.error}")
        self.assertIsNone(self.cpu.error)

    def test_display_shows_digits_after_key_presses(self):
        self._run(5000)
        before = self.board.display.text()
        if hasattr(self.board.keyboard, "press"):
            self.board.keyboard.press("5")
            self._run(20000)
            self.board.keyboard.release("5")
            self._run(5000)
        else:                                   # pragma: no cover
            self.board.keyboard.tap("5")
            self._run(20000)
        after = self.board.display.text()
        self.assertNotEqual(before, after,
                            "индикатор платы не изменился после нажатия '5'")
        self.assertIn("5", after)

    def test_receipt_reaches_the_board_printer(self):
        self._run(5000)
        for key in "500":
            self.board.keyboard.press(key)
            self._run(4000)
            self.board.keyboard.release(key)
            self._run(1500)
        self.board.keyboard.press("СУММА")
        self._run(20000)
        self.board.keyboard.release("СУММА")
        self._run(4000)
        text = self.board.printer.text()
        self.assertIn("5.00", text)
        self.assertIn("ДЕМО-ПРОГРАММА", text)

So the carry from byte0's high nibble didn't propagate to byte1 in the *second* shift... wait, after "2": byte0=0x12, byte1=0. Shifting: byte0: carry_out = 1 (high nibble of 0x12), new byte0 = (0x12<<4)&0xF0 | carry_in(0) = 0x20. byte1: new = (0<<4)|carry_in(1) = 0x01 ✓. So byte1 should be 0x01.         ADD  A, #3

        MOV  R3, A
        ANL  A, #0xF0
        SWAP A
        MOV  R5, A                      ; перенос в следующий байт
        MOV  A, R3
        SWAP A
        ANL  A, #0xF0
        ORL  A, R6
        MOV  @R0, A
        MOV  A, R5                      ; перенос -> вход следующего байта
        MOV  R6, A
        DEC  R0
        DJNZ R2, BS_L
        RET
```
This processes bytes from high (R1+3) to low (R1+0). The carry flows from high byte to low byte ✓ correct for a left shift.

- byte2 (0x4A): 0
- byte1 (0x49): 0

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Контракт ядра m8051, от которого зависит демо-программа
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TestCoreContract(unittest.TestCase):
    """Проверки ядра, без которых демо-программа не может работать.

    Демо-программа -- обычный машинный код: она вызывает подпрограммы
    (``LCALL``/``RET``) и сравнивает коды клавиш (``CJNE``).  Эти тесты
    фиксируют семантику ядра, чтобы ошибка в нём не выглядела как ошибка
    демо-программы (обе найденные здесь ошибки -- ``push_pc`` и условие
    перехода ``CJNE`` -- были именно такими).
    """

    def _run(self, source: str, steps: int = 10, watch=(0x30, 0x40)) -> CPU8051:
        result = asm51.assemble(source)
        rom = ROM("core-contract")
        rom.load_block(0, result.image)
        cpu = CPU8051(rom, NullBus())
        for _ in range(steps):
            cpu.step()
            if cpu.pc in watch:
                break
        return cpu

    _CJNE = (
        "        ORG 0\n"
        "{setup}\n"
        "        CJNE {ops},T\n"
        "        LJMP 0x0030\n"
        "        ORG 0x20\n"
        "T:      LJMP 0x0040\n"
    )

    def _cjne_jumps(self, setup: str, ops: str) -> bool:
        cpu = self._run(self._CJNE.format(setup=setup, ops=ops))
        self.assertIn(cpu.pc, (0x30, 0x40), "CJNE не дошёл до ветки")
        return cpu.pc == 0x40

    def test_cjne_a_immediate(self):
        self.assertTrue(self._cjne_jumps("        MOV A,#5", "A,#2"),
                        "CJNE A,#2 при A=5 обязан перейти (не равно)")
        self.assertTrue(self._cjne_jumps("        MOV A,#2", "A,#5"),
                        "CJNE A,#5 при A=2 обязан перейти (не равно)")
        self.assertFalse(self._cjne_jumps("        MOV A,#5", "A,#5"),
                         "CJNE A,#5 при A=5 не должен переходить (равно)")

    def test_cjne_a_direct_and_registers(self):
        self.assertTrue(self._cjne_jumps("        MOV A,#9\n"
                                         "        MOV 30h,#4", "A,30h"))
        self.assertFalse(self._cjne_jumps("        MOV A,#4\n"
                                          "        MOV 30h,#4", "A,30h"))
        self.assertTrue(self._cjne_jumps("        MOV R0,#5", "R0,#2"))
        self.assertFalse(self._cjne_jumps("        MOV R0,#5", "R0,#5"))
        self.assertTrue(self._cjne_jumps("        MOV R0,#31h\n"
                                         "        MOV @R0,#7", "@R0,#3"))
        self.assertFalse(self._cjne_jumps("        MOV R0,#31h\n"
                                          "        MOV @R0,#7", "@R0,#7"))

    def test_cjne_sets_carry_for_unsigned_less_than(self):
        # A=2 < 5 -> CY=1 -> JC берёт ветку; A=9 > 5 -> CY=0.
        low = self._run("        ORG 0\n        MOV A,#2\n"
                        "        CJNE A,#5,T\n        LJMP 0x0030\n"
                        "        ORG 0x20\nT:      JC 0x0040\n"
                        "        LJMP 0x0030\n")
        self.assertEqual(low.pc, 0x40, "CJNE должен ставить CY при A<#imm")

    def test_lcall_ret_returns_to_the_right_address(self):
        cpu = self._run(
            "        ORG 0\n"
            "        LCALL SUB\n"
            "        LJMP 0x0030\n"
            "        ORG 0x20\n"
            "SUB:    MOV A,#5Ah\n"
            "        RET\n", steps=8)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x30, "RET вернулся не по адресу вызова")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x5A)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x07, "SP не восстановился после RET")

    def test_push_pop_round_trip(self):
        cpu = self._run(
            "        ORG 0\n"
            "        MOV A,#11h\n"
            "        PUSH ACC\n"
            "        MOV A,#22h\n"
            "        POP ACC\n"
            "        LJMP 0x0030\n", steps=8)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x30)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x11)

    def test_conditional_jumps_used_by_the_demo(self):
        cases = (
            ("        MOV A,#0\n        JZ  T", True),
            ("        MOV A,#1\n        JZ  T", False),
            ("        MOV A,#1\n        JNZ T", True),
            ("        CLR C\n        JC  T", False),
            ("        SETB C\n        JC  T", True),
            ("        SETB C\n        JNC T", False),
            ("        MOV R2,#2\n        DJNZ R2,T", True),
            ("        MOV R2,#1\n        DJNZ R2,T", False),
        )
        for setup, expected in cases:
            with self.subTest(setup=setup.strip()):
                cpu = self._run(
                    "        ORG 0\n"
                    f"{setup}\n"
                    "        LJMP 0x0030\n"
                    "        ORG 0x20\n"
                    "T:      LJMP 0x0040\n")
                self.assertEqual(cpu.pc == 0x40, expected,
                                 f"{setup!r}: неверное поведение перехода")

- AC: set iff carry out of bit 3; always updated.
- OV: set iff carry into bit 7 != carry out of bit 7 → `(a ^ result) & (operand ^ result) & 0x80` ✓ (already handled; the current code sets `psw |= 0x04` but never clears OV either! `psw = sfr & 0xC0` doesn't include OV bit 0x04, so `psw |= 0x04` sets it but never clears → OV is sticky too.)

def _add(self, operand, carry_in):
    a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
    result = a + operand + (1 if carry_in else 0)
    psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xF8      # keep RS0,RS1,F0 (bits 3..5); clear CY,AC,OV,P

    if result > 0xFF:
        psw |= 0x80                      # CY

    if (a ^ value) & (operand ^ value) & 0x80:
        psw |= 0x04                      # OV
    self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
    self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]

    # -- флаги арифметики: на них держится вся BCD-арифметика демо ---------
    def _flags(self, body: str) -> CPU8051:
        return self._run(
            "        ORG 0\n"
            f"{body}\n"
            "L:      SJMP L\n", steps=40, watch=())

    def test_add_updates_auxiliary_carry_both_ways(self):
        cpu = self._flags(
            "        MOV A,#08h\n"
            "        ADD A,#08h          ; AC=1\n"
            "        MOV A,#10h\n"
            "        ADD A,#01h          ; переноса из младшей тетрады нет\n"
            "        DA  A               ; AC должен быть сброшен -> 10h\n"
            "        MOV 30h,A")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x30], 0x10,
                         "stale AC: DA A добавила 6 (получилось 0x%02X)"
                         % cpu.ram[0x30])

    def test_add_updates_carry_both_ways(self):
        cpu = self._flags(
            "        MOV A,#0FFh\n"
            "        ADD A,#02h          ; CY=1\n"
            "        MOV A,#01h\n"
            "        ADD A,#01h          ; CY должен быть сброшен\n"
            "        CLR A\n"
            "        RLC A\n"
            "        MOV 30h,A")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x30], 0,
                         "stale CY остался после ADD без переноса")

    def test_sub_updates_carry_both_ways(self):
        cpu = self._flags(
            "        CLR C\n"
            "        MOV A,#02h\n"
            "        SUBB A,#05h         ; заём -> CY=1\n"
            "        MOV A,#05h\n"
            "        SUBB A,#02h         ; CY должен быть сброшен\n"
            "        CLR A\n"
            "        RLC A\n"
            "        MOV 30h,A")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x30], 0,
                         "stale CY остался после SUBB без заёма")

    def test_bcd_idiom_used_by_the_receipt(self):
        # ровно то, что делает BCD_ADD4: ADD + DA A поверх «грязных» флагов
        cpu = self._flags(
            "        MOV A,#08h\n"
            "        ADD A,#08h          ; выставить AC\n"
            "        MOV A,#50h\n"
            "        ADD A,#00h\n"
            "        DA  A               ; 0x50 + 0 -> 0x50\n"
            "        MOV 30h,A")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x30], 0x50,
                         "BCD 0x50+0 дало 0x%02X" % cpu.ram[0x30])

    def test_add_preserves_register_bank_bits(self):
        cpu = self._flags(
            "        SETB PSW.3           ; RS0=1 -> банк 1\n"
            "        MOV A,#01h\n"
            "        ADD A,#01h\n"
            "        MOV 30h,PSW")
        self.assertTrue(cpu.ram[0x30] & 0x08,
                        "ADD сбросил PSW.RS0 (банк регистров)")", "old_string": "                self.assertEqual(cpu.pc == 0x40, expected,
                                 f"{setup!r}: неверное поведение перехода")"}

SUBB A, src_byte     ; A = 9A - src - borrow_in

ADD A, R6

Confirmed bug #4: DA A fails when the low-nibble adjustment pushes the high nibble above 9 (0x9A..0x9F). The check must use the adjusted value.

Let me report it, then implement my BCD_SUB4 rewrite (10's complement with a DA-free increment) + the DRAW_MONEY loop fix.

content.arguments:
{"message": "demo-fw: FOURTH core bug in m8051/cpu.py — `_da()` checks the high nibble of the PRE-adjustment accumulator, so DA A is wrong whenever the low-nibble +6 carries into the high nibble (0x9A..0x9F). Your flag fix landed (my receipt now prints the correct "12.50 / 15.50"), so this is the last arithmetic blocker: it still corrupts BCD carries, i.e. exactly the money arithmetic.

WHERE (cpu.py `_da`):
    a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
    if (a & 0x0F) > 9 or (psw & 0x40):
        a += 6
    if ((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] >> 4) > 9) or carry or (a > 0xFF):   # <-- old A, not `a`
        a += 0x60
        carry = 0x80
Intel's DA A adjusts the low nibble first, then tests the *adjusted* high nibble. As written, 0x9A gets +6 -> 0xA0, but the high-nibble test still looks at 0x9A (high nibble 9) and skips the +0x60, so it returns 0xA0 instead of 0x00 with CY=1.

MEASURED (unmodified core):
    MOV A,#9Ah / DA A             -> A=A0 CY=0   (silicon: A=00 CY=1)
    MOV A,#45h / ADD A,#55h / DA  -> A=A0 CY=0   (silicon: A=00 CY=1, 45+55=100)
    MOV A,#99h / ADD A,#01h / DA  -> A=A0 CY=0   (silicon: A=00 CY=1)
Note the last two start from a *valid* BCD addition — this is not a synthetic edge case, it is how a 4-byte BCD running total overflows a byte.

FIX (one line, evaluate the adjusted value):
    def _da(self, cycles: int) -> int:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW]
        carry = psw & 0x80
        if (a & 0x0F) > 9 or (psw & 0x40):
            a += 6
        if (a >> 4) > 9 or carry:          # `a` after the low-nibble adjustment
            a += 0x60
            carry = 0x80
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = a & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = (psw & 0x7F) | carry
        self.set_p()
        return cycles

I am adding these three cases to `TestCoreContract` (DA 0x9A, BCD 45+55, BCD 99+01, each asserting A and CY).

On my side, while waiting: I found my own BCD_SUB4 was wrong independently of the core (I had mis-remembered the "add 0x9A" idiom — its carry comes out as "no borrow = 1", so it does not chain through SUBB correctly; byte 1 came out 0x05 instead of 0x04). I am replacing it with the 10's-complement method (NEG = 10^8 - src computed with a DA-free BCD increment, then dst + NEG), which also keeps CY meaningful: CY=1 after the final byte means dst >= src. Also fixing DRAW_MONEY: it suppressed leading zeros in the wrong direction, so the kopecks cells stayed blank for a whole-ruble value like 1.00.", "target": "lead"}

Wait, there's a problem with `_da` calling `self._flags` with a body that includes `ORG 0` — `_flags` already prepends "        ORG 0\n". Let me check `_flags`:

```python
def _flags(self, body: str) -> CPU8051:
    return self._run(
        "        ORG 0\n"
        f"{body}\n"
        "L:      SJMP L\n", steps=40, watch=())
```
So passing a body with "ORG 0" would produce two ORG directives — the second sets pc back to 0, overwriting. Actually ORG 0 again is fine (it just resets the location counter), but the first body's bytes would already be emitted... In my `_da` I pass "        ORG 0\n<body>\n MOV 30h,A ..." → so the layout is: ORG 0 (from _flags), ORG 0 (mine) then the body, then MOV 30h,A etc. — the second ORG 0 resets to 0 and overwrites nothing (no code before it) ✓ fine. But it's sloppy. Let me remove the inner ORG 0.

Also watch=() means never break, and steps=40 → the SJMP self-loop keeps running but harmless ✓.

Let me fix _da to not prepend ORG 0.

Also note the `_flags` default steps=40; for a DA test we need ~8 steps ✓.

Let me edit.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with `send_message`; you are notified when the run settles.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.
